messages:
Eli (Marketing Ops): Heads-up: monitoring spike in queue latency for hosted inference in us-east-1. Ops flagged this as P2. We have a webinar at 11:00 PT with ~400 registrants — need guidance on whether to postpone and what copy to push to registrants. Also need status page copy and inbound lead autoresponder text.

status-bot: Incident INC-2026-043 created: Elevated request queue latency in us-east-1. Affected customers may see slower responses. Assigned: Ravi.

Jon (Incidents): Root cause looks like autoscaling loop + host oom churn in one pool; some requests are requeued causing added latency. No signs of error responses, mostly timeouts and long tails. Teams are patching the autoscaler and draining bad hosts. ETA 30-60m.

Priya (Comms): Ok. For all outward messaging: keep it concise and avoid technical noise. Recommendation: publish status page now with a one-line impact summary and a note on mitigation. Update cadence every 15 minutes. For webinar: send a short holding note to registrants now that we may need to reschedule and that we'll confirm in 30 minutes. If resolved before that, send a confirmation "still on" email.

Ava (Customer Success): Agree on targeted comms. I'll ping enterprise CSMs and open a public CS thread for any urgent customer escalations. For inbound leads, recommend an autoresponder that acknowledges potential delays and routes urgent buyers to enterprise-sales@redwood.ai.

Ravi (Eng Oncall): Started draining affected hosts and rolling a fix to the autoscaler. Early metric: p95 latency dropping ~20% after first batch. Still monitoring KV cache pressure. If we hit recovery earlier, set cadence to immediate update.

Eli (Marketing Ops): Proposed status page text for publish now (short):

```
Partial service impact in us-east-1 — We are investigating elevated request latency for hosted inference in the us-east-1 region. Engineers are mitigating the issue and working to restore normal response times. Updates every 15 minutes. No customer data exposure detected.
```

Priya (Comms): +1 but change "Partial service impact" -> "Partial degradation" and add a line for affected users: "If you're seeing significant delays, please contact support." Also include next update ETA. Revised draft:

```
Partial degradation in us-east-1 — We are investigating reports of elevated request latency for hosted inference in the us-east-1 region. Our engineers are mitigating the issue and expect to provide the next update in ~15 minutes. No customer data exposure detected. If you're seeing significant delays, please contact support.
```

Eli (Marketing Ops): Approved. I'll publish that now and push a short in-console banner that links to the status page.

Ava (Customer Success): Draft holding email to webinar registrants (very short):

```
Subject: Quick update on today's Redwood webinar

Hi —
We are currently investigating a performance issue that may affect live demos. We may need to reschedule today's webinar. We'll confirm within 30 minutes. Thank you for your patience.

— Redwood Events Team
```

Priya (Comms): Good. Tone is neutral and sets expectations. Also draft a second email for the "still on" case to send if resolved: one line confirming it's proceeding and link to join.

Jon (Incidents): Can we add a note to marketing ops about routing inbound leads? Suggest autoresponder copy for the demo request form and sales@ inbox:

```
Thanks for reaching out — we're currently addressing a performance issue that may delay responses. If this is urgent (purchase evaluation or enterprise onboarding), please email enterprise-sales@redwood.ai or contact your CSM. We'll reply as soon as possible.
```

Eli (Marketing Ops): Perfect. I'll set that on the lead capture flows and update the demo CTA to show a small "delays possible" tooltip linking to the status page.

Ravi (Eng Oncall): Status update: autoscaler fix rolled to 60% of hosts; p95 latency improving, error rates steady. ETA now ~30m. Will post another update at +15m (1763800900).

Priya (Comms): Decision: webinar holding email goes out now (Eli to send), public status page published, in-console banner live, autoresponder set for lead form and sales inbox. Social posts: hold unless impact broadens.

Ava (Customer Success): Sent enterprise CSM broadcast and put note in CS #urgent-escalations channel.

Eli (Marketing Ops): Holding email sent to registrants. Autoresponders and banner are live. Published status page with Priya's revised copy.

Ravi (Eng Oncall): :white_check_mark: Mitigation progressing, monitoring. Next technical update at 1763800900.

Eli (Marketing Ops): Thanks team. After resolution we'll run a short post-incident checklist: 1) confirm webinar status & send follow-up, 2) convert any warm leads that stalled, 3) review messaging timing for future incidents. Please react with :thumbsup: when your tasks complete.

Ava (Customer Success): :thumbsup: enterprise notify done.

Priya (Comms): :thumbsup: status page + draft social saved.

Jon (Incidents): :thumbsup: monitoring and timeline noted.
